description.value: Crafting projectiles is precise work, and the margins for error were small enough that carelessness had consequences you could trace back to yourself. You understand projectiles in a physical, technical sense that most archers never bother to develop, and that understanding transfers to situations where precision matters.

system.skillBonuses: Craft: Fletcher 3, Ranged Combat 3, Perception 3, Wilderness 3, +56 XP
system.startingEquipment:
Quiver
common clothes
work gloves
low boots
system.features: Field Fletching: You can produce functional arrows or bolts from natural materials during a short rest, requiring no tools beyond a knife and access to wood and feathers. The ammunition is serviceable but not sellable. You are also more likely to recover reusable ammunition after a battle.
